    enhanceTimeSeriesAxes('rolling-active-return',data.rolling_active_provided||[],['active_return_pct','tracking_error_pct'],'%');
    enhanceTimeSeriesAxes('drawdown-chart',data.drawdowns||[],['provided_drawdown_pct','optimized_drawdown_pct','benchmark_drawdown_pct'],'Drawdown %');
    enhanceTimeSeriesAxes('rolling-returns-3y',data.rolling_returns_3y||[],['provided_return_pct','optimized_return_pct','benchmark_return_pct'],'Annualized Return %');
    enhanceTimeSeriesAxes('rolling-returns-5y',data.rolling_returns_5y||[],['provided_return_pct','optimized_return_pct','benchmark_return_pct'],'Annualized Return %');

    // 11. Rebuild Up vs. Down into two independent PV-style review blocks: table then return-vs-benchmark scatter.
    const renderUpDown=()=>{const host=chart('up-down-market'),slot=tableSlot('up-down-market');if(!host)return;host.innerHTML='';if(slot)slot.style.display='none';const perf=records('up_down_market_performance');const panels=[{key:'provided',label:'Provided Portfolio',rows:data.up_down_scatter_provided||[]},{key:'optimized',label:optimizedLabel,rows:data.up_down_scatter_optimized||[]}];panels.forEach(p=>{const wrap=document.createElement('div');wrap.className='ud-panel';wrap.innerHTML=`<h3>${esc(p.label)} vs. ${esc(benchmarkLabel)}</h3><div class="table-slot"></div><div class="ud-chart"></div>`;host.appendChild(wrap);const rows=perf.filter(r=>r.portfolio===p.key);const up=rows.find(r=>r.market_type==='up'),down=rows.find(r=>r.market_type==='down');const total=(a,b)=>finite(a)&&finite(b)?Number(a)+Number(b):null;const weighted=(a,na,b,nb)=>finite(a)&&finite(b)&&finite(na)&&finite(nb)&&Number(na)+Number(nb)>0?(Number(a)*Number(na)+Number(b)*Number(nb))/(Number(na)+Number(nb)):null;const tableRows=[up&&{label:'Up Market',...up},down&&{label:'Down Market',...(down||{})},(up&&down)?{label:'Total',above_benchmark_count:total(up.above_benchmark_count,down.above_benchmark_count),below_benchmark_count:total(up.below_benchmark_count,down.below_benchmark_count),total_count:total(up.total_count,down.total_count),pct_above_benchmark:100*total(up.above_benchmark_count,down.above_benchmark_count)/total(up.total_count,down.total_count),above_active_return_pct:weighted(up.above_active_return_pct,up.above_benchmark_count,down.above_active_return_pct,down.above_benchmark_count),below_active_return_pct:weighted(up.below_active_return_pct,up.below_benchmark_count,down.below_active_return_pct,down.below_benchmark_count),overall_active_return_pct:weighted(up.overall_active_return_pct,up.total_count,down.overall_active_return_pct,down.total_count)}:null].filter(Boolean);wrap.querySelector('.table-slot').innerHTML=`<table class="feedback-table"><thead><tr><th rowspan="2">Market Type</th><th colspan="4">Occurrences</th><th colspan="3">Average Active Return</th></tr><tr><th>Above Benchmark</th><th>Below Benchmark</th><th>Total</th><th>% Above Benchmark</th><th>Above Benchmark</th><th>Below Benchmark</th><th>Total</th></tr></thead><tbody>${tableRows.map(r=>`<tr><td>${esc(r.label)}</td><td>${r.above_benchmark_count??''}</td><td>${r.below_benchmark_count??''}</td><td>${r.total_count??''}</td><td>${pct(r.pct_above_benchmark)}</td><td>${pct(r.above_active_return_pct)}</td><td>${pct(r.below_active_return_pct)}</td><td>${pct(r.overall_active_return_pct)}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table>`;
      const valid=p.rows.filter(r=>finite(r.benchmark_return_pct)&&finite(r.portfolio_return_pct));if(!valid.length)return;const xv=valid.map(r=>Number(r.benchmark_return_pct)),yv=valid.map(r=>Number(r.portfolio_return_pct)),minX=Math.min(...xv),maxX=Math.max(...xv),minY=Math.min(...yv),maxY=Math.max(...yv),width=1000,height=300,left=62,right=26,top=18,bottom=50,x=v=>left+(v-minX)*(width-left-right)/(maxX-minX||1),y=v=>top+(maxY-v)*(height-top-bottom)/(maxY-minY||1),svg=svgEl('svg',{viewBox:`0 0 ${width} ${height}`});frame(svg,{width,height,left,right,top,bottom,xTicks:niceTicks(minX,maxX,5).map(v=>({value:v,label:`${v.toFixed(1)}%`})),yTicks:niceTicks(minY,maxY,5),xScale:x,yScale:y,yFmt:v=>`${v.toFixed(1)}%`,xTitle:`${benchmarkLabel} Return %`,yTitle:`${p.label} Return %`});const lo=Math.max(minX,minY),hi=Math.min(maxX,maxY);if(lo<hi)svg.appendChild(svgEl('line',{x1:x(lo),y1:y(lo),x2:x(hi),y2:y(hi),stroke:'#94a3b8','stroke-dasharray':'5 4'}));valid.forEach(r=>{const c=svgEl('circle',{cx:x(Number(r.benchmark_return_pct)),cy:y(Number(r.portfolio_return_pct)),r:4,fill:r.market_type==='down'?RED:BLUE,'fill-opacity':.72});c.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>showTip(e,`<b>${esc(monthYear(r.date))}</b><br>${esc(benchmarkLabel)}: ${pct(r.benchmark_return_pct)}<br>${esc(p.label)}: ${pct(r.portfolio_return_pct)}<br>Active Return: ${pct(r.active_return_pct)}`));c.addEventListener('mouseleave',hideTip);svg.appendChild(c);});wrap.querySelector('.ud-chart').appendChild(svg);});};
    renderUpDown();

    // 12. Portfolio Metrics: include Benchmark and the required performance metrics from specification, then advanced metrics.
    const perfSummary=records('performance_summary'), advanced=records('portfolio_metrics'), benchmarkSummary=records('benchmark_summary');
    const metricRows=[];const perfWanted=['Start Balance','End Balance','CAGR','Expected Return','Standard Deviation','Best Year','Worst Year','Maximum Drawdown','Sharpe Ratio (ex-post)','Sortino Ratio'];perfWanted.forEach(name=>{const r=perfSummary.find(x=>x.metric===name);if(r)metricRows.push({metric:name,unit:r.unit,provided:r.provided,optimized:r.optimized,benchmark:r.benchmark});});
    const landmarks=new Map((data.frontier_landmarks||[]).map(r=>[r.kind,r]));metricRows.push({metric:'Sharpe Ratio (ex-ante)',unit:'ratio',provided:landmarks.get('provided')?.sharpe_ratio,optimized:landmarks.get('optimized')?.sharpe_ratio,benchmark:landmarks.get('benchmark')?.sharpe_ratio});
    const activeBy=new Map(benchmarkSummary.map(r=>[String(r.portfolio),r]));metricRows.push({metric:'Active Return',unit:'pct',provided:activeBy.get('provided')?.active_return_pct,optimized:activeBy.get('optimized')?.active_return_pct,benchmark:0});metricRows.push({metric:'Tracking Error',unit:'pct',provided:activeBy.get('provided')?.tracking_error_pct,optimized:activeBy.get('optimized')?.tracking_error_pct,benchmark:0});metricRows.push({metric:'Information Ratio',unit:'ratio',provided:activeBy.get('provided')?.information_ratio,optimized:activeBy.get('optimized')?.information_ratio,benchmark:null});
    advanced.forEach(r=>metricRows.push({metric:String(r.metric).replaceAll('_',' ').replace(/\b\w/g,c=>c.toUpperCase()),unit:r.unit,provided:r.provided,optimized:r.optimized,benchmark:r.benchmark}));
    const metricFormat=(v,r)=>r.unit==='balance'?money(v):r.unit==='pct'||r.unit==='percent'?pct(v):ratio(v);renderTable('portfolio-metrics',metricRows,[{key:'metric',label:'Metric'},{key:'provided',label:'Provided',format:metricFormat},{key:'optimized',label:optimizedLabel,format:metricFormat},{key:'benchmark',label:benchmarkLabel,format:metricFormat}]);

    // 14/16. Asset performance and risk decomposition include asset names.
    const assetStats=records('asset_statistics').map(r=>({...r,name:assetName(r.ticker)}));
    renderTable('asset-performance',assetStats,[{key:'ticker',label:'Ticker'},{key:'name',label:'Name'},{key:'cagr_pct',label:'CAGR',format:pct},{key:'annualized_volatility_pct',label:'Stdev',format:pct},{key:'best_year',label:'Best Year',format:v=>finite(v)?pct(Number(v)*100):'N/A'},{key:'worst_year',label:'Worst Year',format:v=>finite(v)?pct(Number(v)*100):'N/A'},{key:'max_drawdown_pct',label:'Max Drawdown',format:pct},{key:'sharpe_ex_post',label:'Sharpe Ratio',format:ratio},{key:'sortino',label:'Sortino Ratio',format:ratio}]);
    renderTable('risk-decomposition',records('risk_decomposition').map(r=>({...r,name:assetName(r.ticker)})),[{key:'name',label:'Name'},{key:'ticker',label:'Ticker'},{key:'provided_risk_contribution_pct',label:'Provided Risk Contribution',format:pct},{key:'optimized_risk_contribution_pct',label:`${optimizedLabel} Risk Contribution`,format:pct}]);
  };
  if(document.readyState==='complete') setTimeout(run,0); else window.addEventListener('load',()=>setTimeout(run,0),{once:true});
})();
</script>
